papers.title: MANCE: Manifold Aware Concept Erasure
papers.abstract: Concept erasure removes target concepts from representations while preserving other information. MANCE constrains interventions to natural representation manifolds, achieving state-of-the-art nonlinear concept erasure across text and vision tasks.

papers.title: KVpop -- Key-Value Cache Compression with Predictive Online Pruning
papers.abstract: KVpop learns optimal KV cache eviction by supervising keep-or-drop decisions using future-attention targets, achieving high performance with significant memory reduction on mathematical reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Multi-Turn Agentic Scientific Literature Search via Workflow Induction
papers.abstract: PaperPilot is a multi-turn literature search agent that constructs executable DAGs of paper-search operators and refines workflows based on user feedback, substantially improving search accuracy metrics.

papers.title: Perceptual Flow Matching for Few-Step Generative Modeling
papers.abstract: PFM supervises flow matching in perceptual feature space rather than VAE latent space, enabling efficient few-step generation for images, videos, and editing with minimal modifications.

papers.title: Unified Audio Intelligence Without Regressing on Text Intelligence
papers.abstract: Audex is a unified audio-text LLM delivering state-of-the-art performance across speech recognition, text-to-speech, and audio generation while preserving strong text reasoning capabilities and knowledge.

papers.title: MV-Forcing: Long Multi-View Video Generation via 4D-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Self-Forcing
papers.abstract: MV-Forcing generates long, multi-view consistent videos through temporal and view-wise autoregression with 4D geometric bridging and spatio-temporal distillation for dynamic scene synthesis.

papers.title: SeKV: Resolution-Adaptive KV Cache with Hierarchical Semantic Memory for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract: SeKV compresses KV cache using entropy-guided semantic spans stored across GPU-CPU hierarchies with selective token-level reconstruction, reducing GPU memory by 53.3% at 128K context.

papers.title: Transition-Aware best-of-N sampling for Longitudinal Chest X-ray Reports
papers.abstract: A training-free best-of-N sampling method for chest X-ray report generation that encodes longitudinal patient history transitions through set-to-set distance metrics and cached ground-truth vectors.

papers.title: Speaker-Aware Temporal Aggregation Strategies on Segment Representations for Depression Detection in Dyadic Interaction: A Benchmark Study
papers.abstract: DEPOOL benchmark reveals temporal aggregation inconsistencies across speech backbones for depression detection, highlighting robustness concerns for clinical speech-based prediction systems.

papers.title: CONFLUX: A Latent Diffusion Model for 3D Chest-CT Synthesis with RL Post-Training
papers.abstract: CONFLUX generates controllable 3D chest CT volumes using latent diffusion with reinforcement learning post-training, improving clinical attribute reliability by 47% over baseline models.

cc_updates.body: Added a warning when your login is about to expire, so you can re-authenticate before background sessions are interrupted. Added a grey pause badge to the footer when in manual permission mode, making the active mode always visible. Added the session's additional working directories to MCP roots/list, with notifications/roots/list_changed sent when the set changes. Fixed opening or switching background agent sessions on macOS stalling for 15-20 seconds due to a false low-memory detection (regression in 2.1.196). Fixed background sessions becoming permanently unresponsive to attach, replies, and stop when the daemon's session token went stale.

Added a Dynamic workflow size setting in /config for controlling how large Claude generally makes dynamic workflows (small/medium/large agent counts). Added workflow.run_id and workflow.name OpenTelemetry attributes to telemetry emitted by workflow-spawned agents. Fixed a crash in the inline Ctrl+R history search when accepting or cancelling while the search was still scanning the history file. Fixed /rename on background sessions being reverted when the job restarts.
Claude Sonnet 5 sessions no longer use the mid-conversation system role for harness reminders.
